title: Homework set: real-life graphs (distance-time and speed-time)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 67 (Complete the portal's real-life graphs set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Calculator allowed. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: A cyclist travels 18 km in 45 minutes. Work out the average speed in km/h.
A distance-time graph is a straight line from (0 min, 0 km) to (20 min, 6 km). Work out the speed in km/h.
An object speeds up uniformly from rest to 15 m/s in 5 s. Work out its acceleration.
The object then travels at 15 m/s for 8 s and then slows uniformly to rest in 10 s. Work out the total distance travelled in the 23 seconds.
Work out the deceleration in the last 10 seconds.
Work out the average speed for the whole 23 seconds, to 3 significant figures.
